## Featured Projects

### Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning
- **[PhotoLift](https://github.com/EmericFDS/PhotoLift)**: High-performance desktop application for batch photo management, AI-assisted sorting, and instant touch-ups.
- **[CVite](https://cvite.emericfds.com/)**: Intelligent resume builder platform powered by AI document extraction, NLP, and real-time layout customizer.
- **[Smart Bucket](https://smartbucket.emericfds.com/)**: Autonomous crypto portfolio management system with real-time sentiment analysis, automated rebalancing, and low-latency execution.
- **[Autonomous RAG Agent](https://github.com/EmericFDS)**: Enterprise document retrieval and multi-step reasoning agent with vector similarity search.
- **[Real-time Object Detection](https://github.com/EmericFDS)**: High-throughput video stream analysis pipeline utilizing YOLOv8 and OpenCV.

### Web Applications & Creative Tools
- **[GhostLink](https://ghostlink.emericfds.com/)**: Zero-knowledge secret sharing utility with client-side AES-256 encryption. The link is the key; zero server-side storage.
- **[Portfolio Canvas UI](https://emericfds.com/)**: High-performance interactive portfolio featuring 60 FPS generative constellation canvas, spotlight bento cards, and 100% Lighthouse audit compliance.
